```{r}
  new.pkg <- pkg[!(pkg %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"])] # Code Vansteelant
  if (length(new.pkg)) 
    install.packages(new.pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
  sapply(pkg, require, character.only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
for (yr in 2020:2026) {

    filename <- paste0("era5_wind925_sahara_", yr, sprintf("%02d", mo), ".nc")
    
    # Sauter si déjà téléchargé

      cat("⏭ Déjà présent :", filename, "\n")
      next
    }
    
    request <- list(
      dataset_short_name = "reanalysis-era5-pressure-levels",
      product_type   = "reanalysis",
      variable       = c("u_component_of_wind", "v_component_of_wind"),
      pressure_level = "925", # 850hPa Equivaux à 1500m d'altitude, sinon 925hPa pour  hPa~750 m
      year           = as.character(yr),
      month          = sprintf("%02d", mo),
      day            = sprintf("%02d", 1:31),
      time           = sprintf("%02d:00", 0:23),
      area           = area_bbox,
      data_format    = "netcdf",
      target         = filename
    )
    
    tryCatch({
      wf_request(request = request, transfer = TRUE, path = ".")
      cat("✓ Téléchargé :", yr, sprintf("%02d", mo), "\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("✗ Erreur :", yr, sprintf("%02d", mo), "-", conditionMessage(e), "\n")

}


# Inspecter le premier fichier
nc <- nc_open("era5_wind925_sahara_202001.nc")
print(nc)  # affiche toutes les variables et dimensions disponibles
nc_close(nc)


# Lire et mettre au format NCEP et stocker


read_era5_wind <- function(yr, mo) {
  filename <- paste0("era5_wind925_sahara_", yr, sprintf("%02d", mo), ".nc")
  if (!file.exists(filename)) {
    cat("Manquant :", filename, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  nc         <- nc_open(filename)
  lon        <- ncvar_get(nc, "longitude")
  lat        <- ncvar_get(nc, "latitude")
  valid_time <- ncvar_get(nc, "valid_time")       # secondes depuis 1970-01-01
  u          <- ncvar_get(nc, "u")                # [lon, lat, pressure_level, time]
  v          <- ncvar_get(nc, "v")
  nc_close(nc)
  
  dates <- as.POSIXct(valid_time, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")
  
  # u/v sont [lon, lat, 1, time] → on supprime la dimension pressure_level
  u <- drop(u)  # devient [lon, lat, time]
  v <- drop(v)
  
  grid       <- expand.grid(longitude = lon, latitude = lat, datetime = dates)
  grid$uwnd  <- as.vector(u)
  grid$vwnd  <- as.vector(v)
  
  return(grid)
}

# Lire et assembler tout
winds <- bind_rows(lapply(2020:2026, function(yr) {
  bind_rows(lapply(1:12, function(mo) read_era5_wind(yr, mo)))
}))

str(winds)
# 'data.frame': X obs. of 4 variables:
#  $ datetime  : POSIXct
#  $ latitude  : num
#  $ longitude : num
#  $ uwnd      : num   (m/s, positif = vers l'est)
#  $ vwnd      : num   (m/s, positif = vers le nord)

# RDS — 5-10x plus petit, lecture rapide
saveRDS(winds,
        file = here("Alice/Data_analysis_June_2026/Analyses/winds_era5_925hPa_2020_2026.rds"))
```

```{r}
destinations <- data_sub5 %>%

    theta_reference = bearing(

      cbind(dest_lon, dest_lat)

    theta_reference = ifelse(theta_reference > 180, theta_reference - 360, theta_reference)
  )
```

## Créer des segments

"High-frequency bursts (GPS-position every 3 seconds) were subsampled to the basic 10 minute \# Nous on a 5min sampling rate. For the current analysis data from 19 individuals that completed at least one autumn and one spring migration was used. Several of these individuals were tracked for multiple years. Each track was assigned a unique ID based on bird ID (name of the bird), season (autumn or spring migration), and year (2009-2015). The GPS-data were subdivided in daily (first and last position of the day) and hourly (first and last position of the hour) flight segments. For each GPS-location, it was determined whether the bird was flying or sitting, based on the instantaneous speed recorded by the GPS logger. The frequency distribution of instantaneous flight speeds was strongly bi-modal and we used a threshold value of 2.0 m/s to distinguish between sitting and flying. Only hourly flight sections that had at least five consecutive flight positions were selected (i.e. in this way possible flight-and-forage behaviour was excluded). Also the few segments where the bird was migrating during the night were excluded. Furthermore, only days with at least four hourly segments and tracks with at least 10 migration days were selected."

```{r}
# Seulement garder les individus qui ont eu au moins une migration de printemps et une d'automne? -> On va pas faire ça

# Garder que les positions de jour
data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  filter(daynight_0 == "day")

# Créer un ID par segment
data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(track_ID = paste(individual.local.identifier, MIGRATION, year, sep = "_"))

# Filtre : seulement les hourly segments avec au moins 5 moves successifs
hourly_filtered <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(hour = floor_date(timestamp, "hour")) %>%
  group_by(track_ID, hour) %>%
  arrange(timestamp) %>%
  filter(sum(move_2 == "move", na.rm = TRUE) >= 5) %>%
  ungroup()

# Hourly segments
hourly_segments <- hourly_filtered %>%
  mutate(hour = as.POSIXct(hour, tz = "UTC")) %>%
  group_by(track_ID, hour) %>%
  summarise(
    first_lon       = first(location.long),
    first_lat       = first(location.lat),
    last_lon        = last(location.long),
    last_lat        = last(location.lat),
    n_moves         = sum(move_2 == "move"),
    theta_reference = first(theta_reference),
    age_group       = first(age_group),
    MIGRATION       = first(MIGRATION),
    year            = first(year),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Daily segments (au moins 4 hourly segments par jour)
daily_segments <- hourly_segments %>%
  mutate(date_day = as.Date(hour)) %>%
  group_by(track_ID, date_day) %>%
  filter(n() >= 4) %>%
  summarise(
    first_lon       = first(first_lon),
    first_lat       = first(first_lat),
    last_lon        = last(last_lon),
    last_lat        = last(last_lat),
    theta_reference = first(theta_reference),
    n_hours         = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Filtrer les tracks avec au moins 2 jours de migration
daily_segments <- daily_segments %>%
  group_by(track_ID) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup()


# Séléction seulement les hourly segments qui ont plus de 5 move successifs sont conservés
# Pour les daily segments, seulement ceux avec au moins 4 hourly segment sont conservés
# Et les tracks totaux sont conservés seulement si ils ont au mois 10 (# Nous 2) jours de migration # -> Trop pour nous
```

## Calculs mouvement

```{r}
# Theta_segment : cap de déplacement du segment
hourly_segments <- hourly_segments %>%
  mutate(
    theta_segment = bearing(
      cbind(first_lon, first_lat),
      cbind(last_lon, last_lat)
    )
  )


# Distance

# Il calcule une distance par segment avec Geosphère. Moi j'ai déjà mes distances calculées entre chaque point subsamplés à 5min.
# Et ensuite il calcule  segment speed, la vitesse par segment
# Peut être une bonne idée dans data_sub5 et on a ground_speed par point.

### Calcul de la distance par segment avec Geosphere
# Rq (je suis pas fan de cette méthode, on a les disances plus précises entre points subsamplés à 5 min, étrange de recalculer beaucoup plus approximativement, peut être pour une cohérence par la suite? A voir)

# Distance par segment (approximation premier-dernier point)
hourly_segments <- hourly_segments %>%
  mutate(
    distance_m     = distHaversine(cbind(first_lon, first_lat), cbind(last_lon, last_lat)),
    segment_speed  = distance_m / 3600  # m/s (1h = 3600 secondes)
  )

daily_segments <- daily_segments %>%
  mutate(
    distance_m = distHaversine(cbind(first_lon, first_lat), cbind(last_lon, last_lat))
  )

# Distance précise : somme des distances point-à-point par segment horaire
dist_precise <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(hour = floor_date(timestamp, "hour")) %>%
  group_by(track_ID, hour) %>%
  summarise(distance_m_precise = sum(ddist_2D, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(hour = as.POSIXct(hour, tz = "UTC"))

hourly_segments <- hourly_segments %>%
  left_join(dist_precise, by = c("track_ID", "hour"))
```

## Calculs vent et join

```{r}
### Calcul de la vitesse vectorielle du vent, direction et angle


### Assignation du vent aux hourly_segments ###
hourly_segments$uwnd       <- NA
hourly_segments$vwnd       <- NA
hourly_segments$wind_speed <- NA
hourly_segments$wind_dir   <- NA
hourly_segments$wind_alfa  <- NA

for (yr in 2020:2026) {
  for (mo in 1:12) {
    
    filename <- paste0("era5_wind925_sahara_", yr, sprintf("%02d", mo), ".nc")
    if (!file.exists(filename)) next
    
    nc         <- nc_open(filename)
    lon        <- ncvar_get(nc, "longitude")
    lat        <- ncvar_get(nc, "latitude")
    valid_time <- ncvar_get(nc, "valid_time")
    u          <- drop(ncvar_get(nc, "u"))
    v          <- drop(ncvar_get(nc, "v"))
    nc_close(nc)
    
    dates <- as.POSIXct(valid_time, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")
    
    idx_seg <- which(format(hourly_segments$hour, "%Y%m") == sprintf("%d%02d", yr, mo))
    if (length(idx_seg) == 0) { rm(u, v, dates, valid_time); gc(); next }
    
    for (i in idx_seg) {
      
      t_seg <- hourly_segments$hour[i]
      idx_t <- which(dates == t_seg)
      if (length(idx_t) == 0) idx_t <- which(abs(as.numeric(dates) - as.numeric(t_seg)) <= 3600)
      if (length(idx_t) == 0) next
      
      # Trouver l'index lon et lat les plus proches séparément
      best_lon <- which.min(abs(lon - hourly_segments$first_lon[i]))
      best_lat <- which.min(abs(lat - hourly_segments$first_lat[i]))
      
      uw <- u[best_lon, best_lat, idx_t[1]]
      vw <- v[best_lon, best_lat, idx_t[1]]
      
      hourly_segments$uwnd[i]       <- uw
      hourly_segments$vwnd[i]       <- vw
      hourly_segments$wind_speed[i] <- sqrt(uw^2 + vw^2)
      hourly_segments$wind_dir[i]   <- atan2(vw, uw) * 180 / pi
      hourly_segments$wind_alfa[i]  <- 90 - (atan2(vw, uw) * 180 / pi)
    }
    
    rm(u, v, dates, valid_time)
    gc()
    cat("✓ Traité :", yr, sprintf("%02d", mo), "\n")
  }
}
summary(hourly_segments$uwnd)
summary(hourly_segments$vwnd)
```

### 2. Climatologie ("prevailing")

```{r}
library(ncdf4)

season <- "autumn"  # ou "spring"
season_months <- if (season == "autumn") 8:12 else 1:7

u_count_west <- NULL  # cumul du nb de pas de temps avec U<0, par cellule
n_count      <- NULL  # cumul du nb de pas de temps valides, par cellule
grid_lon <- NULL
grid_lat <- NULL

for (yr in 2020:2026) {
  for (mo in season_months) {

    filename <- paste0("era5_wind925_sahara_", yr, sprintf("%02d", mo), ".nc")
    if (!file.exists(filename)) next

    nc  <- nc_open(filename)
    lon <- ncvar_get(nc, "longitude")
    lat <- ncvar_get(nc, "latitude")
    u   <- drop(ncvar_get(nc, "u"))  # dims : lon, lat, time
    nc_close(nc)

    if (is.null(grid_lon)) {
      grid_lon <- lon
      grid_lat <- lat
      u_count_west <- array(0, dim = c(length(lon), length(lat)))
      n_count      <- array(0, dim = c(length(lon), length(lat)))
    }

    u_count_west <- u_count_west + apply(u < 0, c(1, 2), sum, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_count      <- n_count      + apply(!is.na(u), c(1, 2), sum)

    rm(u)
    gc()
    cat("✓ Climato traitée :", yr, sprintf("%02d", mo), "\n")
  }
}

freq_west <- u_count_west / n_count
freq_east <- 1 - freq_west

clim_df <- expand.grid(lon = grid_lon, lat = grid_lat) %>%
  mutate(
    freq_west = as.vector(freq_west),
    freq_east = as.vector(freq_east)
  )
```

## Calculs finaux

### Forward_speed & Perpendicular_speed

```{r}

#### Hourly_segments
deg2rad <- function(x) x * pi / 180

# Forward speed
hourly_segments <- hourly_segments %>%
  mutate(
    forward_speed = segment_speed * cos(deg2rad(theta_reference - theta_segment))
  )

# Perpendicular speed
hourly_segments <- hourly_segments %>%
  mutate(
    perpendicular_speed = -segment_speed * sin(deg2rad(theta_reference - theta_segment))
  )

```

### Tailwind & Crosswind

```{r}

#Tailwind = wind speed × cos(θ_reference – θ_wind) 
#Crosswind = – wind speed × sin(θ_reference – θ_wind) 
# => Drift ratio (DR) (perpendicular speed / crosswind)


# Rq : On va changer un peu cette méthode : on a déjà les vecteurs de vent uwnd et vwnd donc on peut faire une version vectorielle

# Direction des oiseaux
deg2rad <- function(x) x * pi / 180

hourly_segments <- hourly_segments %>%
  mutate(theta_rad = deg2rad(theta_reference))

# Vecteur directeur de l'oiseau
hourly_segments <- hourly_segments %>%
  mutate(
    ux = sin(theta_rad),
    uy = cos(theta_rad)
  )

## 
# Tailwind (projection du vent sur la trajectoire)
hourly_segments <- hourly_segments %>%
  mutate(
    tailwind = uwnd * ux + vwnd * uy
  )
# Crosswind (composante perpendiculaire)
hourly_segments <- hourly_segments %>%
  mutate(
    crosswind = -uwnd * uy + vwnd * ux
  )


## Vérifications
summary(hourly_segments[, c("perpendicular_speed", "crosswind")])
head(hourly_segments[, c("perpendicular_speed", "crosswind")])
```

### Drift_ratio

```{r}
# Vérifications
summary(hourly_segments$theta_segment)
summary(hourly_segments$crosswind)
summary(hourly_segments$tailwind)

# Calcul drift_ratio
hourly_segments <- hourly_segments %>%
  mutate(
    drift_ratio = perpendicular_speed / crosswind
  )

# Sinon, pour fonctionner comme Vansteelant voir suite

################################################################################
####        CLASSIFY COMPENSATION BASED ON U COMP MOVE AND WIND         ########
################################################################################

# Vansteelant| Alice                 |
# ---------- | --------------------- |
# spd.sw     | `perpendicular_speed` |
# sidewind   | `crosswind`           |


hourly_segments$stw <- hourly_segments$perpendicular_speed/hourly_segments$crosswind
hourly_segments$comp <- rep('0')
hourly_segments[which(abs(hourly_segments$crosswind)*3.6 < 5),]$comp <- 'NSW'
hourly_segments[which(abs(hourly_segments$crosswind)*3.6 < 5 & sign(hourly_segments$crosswind) == sign(hourly_segments$perpendicular_speed) & abs(hourly_segments$perpendicular_speed)*3.6 >= 5),]$comp <- 'OD'
hourly_segments[which(abs(hourly_segments$crosswind)*3.6 < 5 & sign(hourly_segments$crosswind) != sign(hourly_segments$perpendicular_speed) & abs(hourly_segments$perpendicular_speed)*3.6 >= 5),]$comp <- 'OC'
hourly_segments[which(abs(hourly_segments$crosswind)*3.6 >= 5 & abs(hourly_segments$stw) <= 0.2),]$comp <- 'FC'
hourly_segments[which(abs(hourly_segments$crosswind)*3.6 >= 5 & sign(hourly_segments$crosswind) == sign(hourly_segments$perpendicular_speed) & abs(hourly_segments$stw) > 0.2 & abs(hourly_segments$stw) < 0.8),]$comp <- 'PC'
hourly_segments[which(abs(hourly_segments$crosswind)*3.6 >= 5 & sign(hourly_segments$crosswind) != sign(hourly_segments$perpendicular_speed) & abs(hourly_segments$stw) > 0.2 & abs(hourly_segments$stw) < 0.8),]$comp <- 'OC'
hourly_segments[which(abs(hourly_segments$crosswind)*3.6 >= 5 & sign(hourly_segments$crosswind) == sign(hourly_segments$perpendicular_speed) & abs(hourly_segments$stw) >= 0.8 & abs(hourly_segments$stw) < 1.2),]$comp <- 'FD'
hourly_segments[which(abs(hourly_segments$crosswind)*3.6 >= 5 & sign(hourly_segments$crosswind) != sign(hourly_segments$perpendicular_speed) & abs(hourly_segments$stw) >= 0.8 & abs(hourly_segments$stw) < 1.2),]$comp <- 'OC'
hourly_segments[which(abs(hourly_segments$crosswind)*3.6 >= 5 & sign(hourly_segments$crosswind) == sign(hourly_segments$perpendicular_speed) & abs(hourly_segments$stw) >= 1.2),]$comp <- 'OD'
hourly_segments[which(abs(hourly_segments$crosswind)*3.6 >= 5 & sign(hourly_segments$crosswind) != sign(hourly_segments$perpendicular_speed) & abs(hourly_segments$perpendicular_speed) >= 1.2),]$comp <- 'OC' 



# "Orientation responses were classified as 
#over-drift (DO, i.e. heading downwind from the GCR), 
#full drift (DF), 
#partial (CP) or 
#full compensatation (CF, i.e. staying on the GCR through sidewinds), #overcompensation (CO, i.e. heading upwind the GCR). 
#Cases where falcons stayed on the GCR in absence of sidewinds were not classified (NSW)
unique(hourly_segments$comp)
hourly_segments$comp <- as.factor(hourly_segments$comp)
table(hourly_segments$comp)

hourly_segments <- hourly_segments %>%

unique(hourly_segments$MIGRATION)

table(hourly_segments$comp[hourly_segments$MIGRATION == "autumn"])


str(hourly_segments)
```

```{r}
## 7. Comparaisons ciblées par paires (post-hoc), avec correction pour tests multiples
# On compare : juvenile_autumn vs juvenile_spring, adult_autumn vs adult_spring,
# ainsi que autumn (juv vs adult) et spring (juv vs adult) déjà faits plus haut (chisq_autumn / chisq_spring)

    filter(age_group == "juvenile") %>%
    { chisq.test(table(.$MIGRATION, .$comp)) },
  "adult: autumn vs spring" = hourly_segments %>%

  "autumn: adult vs juvenile" = chisq_autumn,
  "spring: adult vs juvenile" = chisq_spring
)

# Extraction des p-values et correction (Holm, plus puissant que Bonferroni)

pvals_adj <- p.adjust(pvals_raw, method = "holm")

pairwise_results <- data.frame(
  comparison = names(pairwise_tests),
  chi2 = sapply(pairwise_tests, function(x) round(x$statistic, 2)),
  df = sapply(pairwise_tests, function(x) x$parameter),
  p_raw = round(pvals_raw, 4),
  p_holm = round(pvals_adj, 4)
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
#### Fonction pour générer le panel A par saison ####
make_panel_a <- function(season) {
  
  freq_by_lat <- hourly_segments %>%
    filter(MIGRATION == season) %>%
    count(lat_bin, comp) %>%
    group_by(lat_bin) %>%
    mutate(freq = n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  ggplot(freq_by_lat, aes(x = lat_bin, y = freq, fill = comp)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = comp_colors) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      x = "Latitude band (°)",
      y = "Relative frequency",
      fill = "Drift/Compensation behavior",
      title = season
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 13),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
    )
}

#### Boucle sur toutes les saisons ####
seasons <- unique(hourly_segments$MIGRATION)
conflicts_prefer(purrr::map)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)

panels_a_by_season <- map(seasons, make_panel_a) %>% 
  setNames(seasons)

#### Combinaison côte à côte avec légende unique ####
```

## Chi-squared comp par rapport au comp de tout le flyway

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

# ================================
# 1. REGROUPEMENT DES CATEGORIES
# ================================
hourly_segments <- hourly_segments %>%
  mutate(comp_group = case_when(
    comp == "OC" ~ "OC",
    comp == "OD" ~ "OD",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

# ================================
# 2. FRÉQUENCE MOYENNE ATTENDUE SUR TOUT LE FLYWAY (par saison)
# ================================
expected_freq <- hourly_segments %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat_bin)) %>%
  count(MIGRATION, comp_group) %>%
  group_by(MIGRATION) %>%
  mutate(expected_pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(MIGRATION, comp_group, expected_pct)

expected_freq

# ================================
# 3. FRÉQUENCE OBSERVÉE PAR BANDE DE LATITUDE
# ================================
observed_freq <- hourly_segments %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat_bin)) %>%
  count(MIGRATION, lat_bin, comp_group) %>%
  group_by(MIGRATION, lat_bin) %>%
  mutate(
    total_band = sum(n),
    observed_pct = 100 * n / total_band
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ================================
# 4. TEST DU CHI² PAR BANDE (bande vs reste, classe vs reste)
#    -> détermine si la bande a significativement PLUS que la moyenne attendue
# ================================
test_significance <- function(migration_val, lat_bin_val, group_val) {
  
  df_season <- hourly_segments %>% filter(MIGRATION == migration_val, !is.na(lat_bin))
  
  in_band   <- df_season$lat_bin == lat_bin_val
  is_group  <- df_season$comp_group == group_val
  
  tbl <- table(in_band, is_group)
  
  if (nrow(tbl) < 2 || ncol(tbl) < 2) return(list(p = NA, higher = FALSE))
  
  test <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tbl))
  
  # Est-ce que la proportion observée dans la bande est SUPÉRIEURE à l'attendu ?
  obs_pct_band <- 100 * sum(in_band & is_group) / sum(in_band)
  exp_pct_all  <- 100 * sum(is_group) / length(is_group)
  
  higher <- obs_pct_band > exp_pct_all
  
  list(p = test$p.value, higher = higher)
}

# Appliquer le test pour chaque combinaison bande x saison x groupe (OC et OD seulement, comme l'article)
sig_results <- observed_freq %>%
  filter(comp_group %in% c("OC", "OD")) %>%
  distinct(MIGRATION, lat_bin, comp_group) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    test = list(test_significance(MIGRATION, lat_bin, comp_group)),
    p_value = test$p,
    higher_than_expected = test$higher,
    significant = !is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05 & higher_than_expected
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(MIGRATION, lat_bin, comp_group, significant)

sig_results

# ================================
# 5. FRÉQUENCES RÉSIDUELLES (observed - expected)
# ================================
table_data <- observed_freq %>%
  left_join(expected_freq, by = c("MIGRATION", "comp_group")) %>%
  mutate(residual_pct = round(observed_pct - expected_pct, 1)) %>%
  left_join(sig_results, by = c("MIGRATION", "lat_bin", "comp_group")) %>%
  mutate(significant = ifelse(is.na(significant), FALSE, significant))

table_data


# ================================
# EXPORT
# ================================
library(writexl)   # export Excel simple
library(flextable)
library(officer)

# Chemin du dossier
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# ================================
# TABLEAU LARGE : une colonne par saison x groupe

  # Réordonne les colonnes exactement comme le tableau modèle : OC, Other, OD par saison

    spring_OC, spring_Other, spring_OD

table_wide

# ================================
ft <- flextable(table_wide) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    lat_bin     = "Latitude [\u00b0]",
    autumn_OC   = "OC",
    autumn_Other = "Other",
    autumn_OD   = "OD",
    spring_OC   = "OC",
    spring_Other = "Other",
    spring_OD   = "OD"
  ) %>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Autumn", "", "", "Spring", "", ""),
    top = TRUE
  ) %>%
  merge_at(i = 1, j = 2:4, part = "header") %>%
  merge_at(i = 1, j = 5:7, part = "header") %>%
  merge_at(i = 1:2, j = 1, part = "header") %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  hline_top(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
  hline(i = 1, part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 0.75)) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
```

```{r}
#### Fonction pour générer les 2 panels par saison ####
make_panels_b <- function(season) {
  
  hourly_segments_west <- hourly_segments %>% 
    filter(MIGRATION == season, uwnd < 0)
  hourly_segments_east <- hourly_segments %>% 
    filter(MIGRATION == season, uwnd >= 0)
  
  panel_b_west <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = clim_df, aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = freq_west)) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "darkseagreen", high = "darkorange", name = "Fréq. vent d'ouest") +
    geom_point(data = hourly_segments_west,
               aes(x = first_lon, y = first_lat, color = comp),
               size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = comp_colors, name = "Comportement") +
    coord_quickmap(xlim = c(-20, 2), ylim = c(17, 34)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste0("Segments avec vent d'ouest rencontré en route — ", season))
  
  panel_b_east <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = clim_df, aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = freq_east)) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "darkseagreen", high = "darkorange", name = "Fréq. vent d'est") +
    geom_point(data = hourly_segments_east,
               aes(x = first_lon, y = first_lat, color = comp),
               size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = comp_colors, name = "Comportement") +
    coord_quickmap(xlim = c(-20, 2), ylim = c(17, 34)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste0("Segments avec vent d'est rencontré en route — ", season))
  
  list(west = panel_b_west, east = panel_b_east)
}

#### Boucle sur toutes les saisons ####
seasons <- unique(hourly_segments$MIGRATION)

panels_by_season <- purrr::map(seasons, make_panels_b) %>% 
  setNames(seasons)

# Affichage (utile en Quarto/RMarkdown : chaque print() sort dans le doc)
for (s in seasons) {
  print(panels_by_season[[s]]$west)
  print(panels_by_season[[s]]$east)
}
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)

## 1. Définition des deux périodes (mois calendaire, indépendant de MIGRATION)

  mutate(
    month = month(hour),
    period = case_when(
      month %in% c(9, 10)  ~ "Sept-Oct",
      month %in% c(2, 3, 4) ~ "Fev-Avril",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

comp_data %>% count(period)

## 2. Modèles mixtes (effet aléatoire oiseau, éventuellement track_ID nichée)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

#### Fonction utilitaire pour extraire la p-value du coefficient du facteur ####
get_p_label <- function(model) {
  coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
  p_val <- coefs[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  if (is.na(p_val)) return("p = NA")
  if (p_val < 0.001) return("p < 0.001")
  paste0("p = ", formatC(p_val, format = "f", digits = 3))
}

## --- 1. Comparaison Septembre vs Octobre ---
comp_autumn <- hourly_segments %>%
  filter(month_name %in% c("Septembre", "Octobre")) %>%
  mutate(month_name = factor(month_name, levels = c("Septembre", "Octobre")))

## --- 3. Graphiques ---

plot_comp <- function(data, var, ylab, title = NULL, p_label = NULL, p_offset = 1.05) {
  y_pos <- max(data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  ggplot(data, aes(x = month_name, y = .data[[var]], fill = month_name)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, trim = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = 1,
      xend = 2,
      y = y_pos,
      yend = y_pos
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_pos * p_offset,
      label = p_label
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      y = ylab,
      x = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    )
}
```

```{R}
#### Extraction des coefficients des 4 modèles ####
extract_coef <- function(model, comparison, variable) {
  coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
  data.frame(
    Comparaison = comparison,
    Variable = variable,
    Estimate = round(coefs[2, "Estimate"], 3),
    SE = round(coefs[2, "Std. Error"], 3),
    t_value = round(coefs[2, "t value"], 3),
    p_value = coefs[2, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    p_label = get_p_label(model)
  )
}

coef_table <- rbind(
  extract_coef(mod_tailwind_aut, "Septembre vs Octobre", "Tailwind"),
  extract_coef(mod_windspeed_aut, "Septembre vs Octobre", "Wind speed"),
  extract_coef(mod_tailwind_spr, "Fevrier vs Avril", "Tailwind"),
  extract_coef(mod_windspeed_spr, "Fevrier vs Avril", "Wind speed")
)

print(coef_table)



# N

#### Extraction du N (observations + nombre d'oiseaux) pour chaque modèle ####
get_n_info <- function(model, data) {
  n_obs <- nobs(model)
  n_birds <- length(unique(data$bird_ID))
  n_tracks <- length(unique(data$track_ID))
  data.frame(
    n_obs = n_obs,
    n_birds = n_birds,
    n_tracks = n_tracks
  )
}

n_table <- rbind(
  cbind(Comparaison = "Septembre vs Octobre", Variable = "Tailwind",
        get_n_info(mod_tailwind_aut, comp_autumn)),
  cbind(Comparaison = "Septembre vs Octobre", Variable = "Wind speed",
        get_n_info(mod_windspeed_aut, comp_autumn)),
  cbind(Comparaison = "Fevrier vs Avril", Variable = "Tailwind",
        get_n_info(mod_tailwind_spr, comp_spring)),
  cbind(Comparaison = "Fevrier vs Avril", Variable = "Wind speed",
        get_n_info(mod_windspeed_spr, comp_spring))
)

print(n_table)
```

```{r}
### Read packages 
ipak <- function(pkg){
  new.pkg <- pkg[!(pkg %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"])]
  if (length(new.pkg)) 
    install.packages(new.pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
  sapply(pkg, require, character.only = TRUE)
}

# usage
packages <- c("RNCEP","rsq")
ipak(packages)

# read all wind data previously extracted by RNCEP
winds <- read.csv('./Figures 2021/EF_migration_traveldays_winddata-v20210105.csv')
winds <- winds[,!(colnames(winds) %in% c("X","travel"))]
winds$dt <- as.POSIXct(strptime(winds$dt, format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), tz='UTC')

# merge movement and wind data
data <- subset(data,data$travel >= 1)
data$yrtrip <- paste(data$trip,data$yr,sep='_')
# Nous yrtrip c'est 

data <- merge(data,winds,all.x=T)

################################################################################
####        DETERMINE INTENDED TRAVEL DIRECTION AT EACH LOC             ########
################################################################################
# determine closest point in Madagascar
# create df for country polygons
#countries <- shapefile("./Maps/ne_50m_admin_0_countries/ne_50m_admin_0_countries.shp")
#countries <- countries[countries$continent %in% c("Europe","Africa","Asia"),]
madagascar <- countries[countries$admin == "Madagascar",]

# for return trips use center point of Alegranza as destination
data$dest.long <- ifelse(data$trip == "return",ale.long,as.numeric(dist2Line(cbind(data$long,data$lat), madagascar, distfun=distGeo)[,2]))
data$dest.lat <- ifelse(data$trip == "return",ale.lat,as.numeric(dist2Line(cbind(data$long,data$lat), madagascar, distfun=distGeo)[,3]))
rm(madagascar)

#calculate intended travel direction as direction to 
# Madagacar (for outbound) and Alegranza (for inbound)
data$itd <- earth.bear(long1=data$long, lat1=data$lat, long2=data$dest.long, lat2=data$dest.lat)
data$itd <- ifelse(data$itd > 180, data$itd-360, data$itd)

# calculate loxodrome distance to goal
#data$dtg <- deg.dist(lat1=data$lat,long1=data$long,lat2=data$dest.lat,long2=data$dest.long)

#######              RECALCULATE WIND                 #############
###################################################################
### DETERMINE ANGLE WIND RELATIVE TO EARTH NORTH FROM U AND V COMPONENTS ### 
data$w <- (data$u^2 + data$v^2)^(1/2)			# determine strength of wind in m/s #
data$alfa <- atan2(data$u/data$w,data$v/data$w)*(180/pi)
data$c_alfa <- circular(data$alfa, units = 'degrees', template ='geographics')

###   CALCULATE SIDEWARD AND FORWARD SPEED OF BIRD AND WIND RELATIVE TO ITD
################################################################################

### determine incident angle of wind, heading and flight direction with itd
data$beta <- data$alfa - data$itd
data$beta <- ifelse(data$beta > 180,data$beta - 360,ifelse(data$beta < -180,data$beta + 360,data$beta))

data$teta <- data$dir - data$itd
data$teta <- ifelse(data$teta > 180,data$teta - 360,ifelse(data$teta < -180,data$teta + 360,data$teta))

## determine forward and sideword movement, active movement and wind movement
data$spd <- data$spd 
data$spd.sw <- data$spd * sin(rad(data$teta))
data$spd.fw <- data$spd * cos(rad(data$teta))

data$sidewind <- data$w * sin(rad(data$beta))
data$tailwind <- data$w * cos(rad(data$beta))

# calcualte realized tailwind
data$gamma <- data$alfa - data$dir
data$gamma <- ifelse(data$gamma > 180,data$gamma - 360,ifelse(data$gamma < -180,data$gamma + 360,data$gamma))
data$sidewind.r <- data$w * sin(rad(data$gamma))
data$tailwind.r <- data$w * cos(rad(data$gamma))

# calculate wind support gain
data$gain <- data$tailwind.r - data$tailwind

################################################################################
####        CLASSIFY COMPENSATION BASED ON U COMP MOVE AND WIND         ########
################################################################################

data$stw <- data$spd.sw/data$sidewind
data$comp <- rep('0')
data[which(abs(data$sidewind)*3.6 < 5),]$comp <- 'NSW'
data[which(abs(data$sidewind)*3.6 < 5 & sign(data$sidewind) == sign(data$spd.sw) & abs(data$spd.sw)*3.6 >= 5),]$comp <- 'DO'
data[which(abs(data$sidewind)*3.6 < 5 & sign(data$sidewind) != sign(data$spd.sw) & abs(data$spd.sw)*3.6 >= 5),]$comp <- 'CO'
data[which(abs(data$sidewind)*3.6 >= 5 & abs(data$stw) <= 0.2),]$comp <- 'CF'
data[which(abs(data$sidewind)*3.6 >= 5 & sign(data$sidewind) == sign(data$spd.sw) & abs(data$stw) > 0.2 & abs(data$stw) < 0.8),]$comp <- 'CP'
data[which(abs(data$sidewind)*3.6 >= 5 & sign(data$sidewind) != sign(data$spd.sw) & abs(data$stw) > 0.2 & abs(data$stw) < 0.8),]$comp <- 'CO'
data[which(abs(data$sidewind)*3.6 >= 5 & sign(data$sidewind) == sign(data$spd.sw) & abs(data$stw) >= 0.8 & abs(data$stw) < 1.2),]$comp <- 'DF'
data[which(abs(data$sidewind)*3.6 >= 5 & sign(data$sidewind) != sign(data$spd.sw) & abs(data$stw) >= 0.8 & abs(data$stw) < 1.2),]$comp <- 'CO'
data[which(abs(data$sidewind)*3.6 >= 5 & sign(data$sidewind) == sign(data$spd.sw) & abs(data$stw) >= 1.2),]$comp <- 'DO'
data[which(abs(data$sidewind)*3.6 >= 5 & sign(data$sidewind) != sign(data$spd.sw) & abs(data$spd.sw) >= 1.2),]$comp <- 'CO'
```
